dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the visible posterior portion.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no discernible localized bulges or structural indentations where the body meets the water surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median skin tone categorized as medium-grey, consistent with a sub-adult or juvenile phase.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, light-colored linear marks and small contrast-disrupting points are visible on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings, likely rake marks or scratches, are visible on the posterior region of the dorsal plane.
